title: purple-mimi 5: rooms and messages
description: Rooms and messages on libpurple 2 (§13 step 5): the purple front end over mimid-agent-store (§5.6), the read and request functions of §5.5, rooms as chats (closing is not leaving), direct rooms as IMs, history on open from the read position, invites through purple's invite dialog, /allow and /deny, topic, members and the admin flag, notices, the Devices dialog, disappearing messages with NO_LOG (§8). About 2,400 to 3,200 lines (estimate).
notes:
2026-11-22 progress. Landed purple-mimi aab9914 (pushed): the §5.6 front end in core/src/purple.rs — the Frontend over the store, change diffing against ext["purple"], message numbering per room, HTML escaping with hostile-input coverage (C0 controls, bidi overrides, zero-width, NUL -> U+FFFD), body cutting on a character boundary, and line rendering for the §8.6-§8.8 text forms. New event kinds Room/Message/Reaction/Person with their change enums. 6 new unit tests, 29 total in core; all gates clean.

Corrected three wrong assumptions about mimid's records, caught by compiling: Reply is a tuple enum (render_line takes the looked-up number); Attachment has no availability flag since a received one enters the record only once fetched, so the diff is the count; reaction_counts returns senders per reaction, not counts.

Still to do for step 5: the ABI reads (mimi_rooms, mimi_room_get, mimi_message_get, mimi_history, mimi_invites, mimi_person_get) and the requests (send_text, send_file, create_room, open_direct, change_members, leave, set_subject, kick/ban/unban, accept/decline_invite, allow/deny, list_devices, mark_shown, save_attachment, command), then the libpurple 2 glue for chats, IMs, history on open, the invite dialog, topic, members and the admin flag, notices and NO_LOG. mimi_decline_invite needs a store call mimid does not have yet (§13 step 3a).
